compose_two_graphs: compose two weighted finite-state transducer graphs using gtn.compose to intersect their languages
compute_forward_score: compute the forward log-sum-exp score of a graph using gtn.forward_score
find_viterbi_path: find the highest-scoring path through a graph using gtn.viterbi_path and gtn.viterbi_score
concatenate_graphs: concatenate multiple graphs into a sequence using gtn.concat to chain their languages
union_graphs: union multiple graphs together using gtn.union to combine their accepted languages
